subject.title: feat(clients): adopt model controls, session management, and keyboard history recall on iOS

question: Should iOS migrate the existing Sessions destination to the gateway-backed shared sheet, or retain a separate local group catalog with explicit synchronization and migration behavior?
rationale: The branch exposes gateway-backed group mutations from chat while another live iOS entry point still owns local group state; choosing the canonical persisted behavior is an ownership and upgrade decision, not a mechanical formatting fix.

options.title: Adopt one gateway-backed catalog
options.body: Move the existing iOS Sessions destination onto the shared gateway-backed group flow and migrate or remove local-only group state.

options.title: Keep local groups with synchronization
options.body: Retain the local catalog only with explicit bidirectional synchronization, migration semantics, and focused cross-entry-point coverage.

recommendation.title: Adopt one gateway-backed catalog
recommendation.body: Move the existing iOS Sessions destination onto the shared gateway-backed group flow and migrate or remove local-only group state.

likelyOwner.reason: They authored the shared native-session rollout and the iOS adoption path that now needs one canonical state owner.
